info.name: Delete a vendor tag by vendor ID and tag ID

params.name: useSystem
params.description: Which system to use for id or updatedAt filters.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to delete a vendor tag association by specifying both the vendor ID and tag ID.

Use `/v0/vendorTags/{id}` when you want to use the vendor tag's ID instead of the vendor ID and tag ID.

info.name: Get a list of vendor tags

params.name: limit
params.description: How many items to return at one time (max 100) (default 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Which item to start from. See [Pagination](#section/Pagination) for more information.

params.name: vendorId
params.description: Filter the results to a single vendor's tag associations.

items.docs: Get a list of vendor tags.

Create a new vendor tag. A vendor is not allowed to have the same tag
attached multiple times.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the vendor tag

items.docs:
Delete a vendor tag association using the vendor tag's ID.

Use `/v0/vendors/{vendor_id}/tags/{tag_id}` when you want to use the vendor ID and tag ID as opposed to the vendor tag's ID.
